#Research Question 

Does Maryland football attendance at regular-season home games vary depending on the outcome of the team's previous game?

#Hypothesis
#Hypothesis 1: 
Maryland home games following a win will have higher attendance on average than home games following a loss.
#Hypothesis 2: 
The relationship between Maryland's previous game result and attendance at its next home game will vary depending on the number of days between games.
#Data and Sources Links

My primary source is the cfbfastR-data GitHub repository, which contains annual CSV files with individual college football game records.(https://github.com/sportsdataverse/cfbfastR-data)

CSV files: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/cfbfastR-data/tree/main/schedules/csv

I plan to use the files from 2011 through 2025. They contain information such as game dates, teams, scores and attendance.

I will also use the CollegeFootballData API documentation to get data that is Maryland specific (when I can figure out how to use API because that is what the site uses to retrieve data, but we haven't gone over that and I couldn't figure it out, so I'm just putting it aside for now and will try to figure it out later):

https://api.collegefootballdata.com/api/docs/

For an extra level to check that data, I plan to check it with the Maryland Football Record Book:

https://s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/sidearm.nextgen.sites/umterps.com/documents/2026/3/10/Football_Record_Book_Thru_2025_021126_Final.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com
